purpose: Measure residual concurrent SSD read duplication and memory publication races without changing lookup decisions
source_identity: raw/source.tar contains the actual working tree, raw/source-manifest.json lists file SHA-256 hashes, raw/current.patch preserves tracked changes, raw/instrumentation.patch adds observation only

instrumentation.records: Memory misses, buffered hits, disk selections, PayloadRead IDs, actual initializer starts and completions, disk returns, memory promotion starts and completions, kernel short completions, EINTR and submission EAGAIN
instrumentation.memory_probe: Non-retaining MemoryCache::get probes after disk selection and after payload read admission. Their results are observed but never change I/O or source decisions
instrumentation.overhead: Mutex-protected in-memory event collection and additional memory shard lookups. CSV is written after measured requests and observation tail
instrumentation.limits: One diagnostic run measures these lifetimes under instrumentation. It does not establish a candidate speedup or production cancellation rates
